title: Cloudways Review (2026)
intro: Cloudways is evaluated here as IT & development software — Cloudways is a managed cloud hosting platform (a DigitalOcean company) that provisions app stacks on cloud VMs instead of selling a Plesk/cPanel panel licence. Flexible publishes from $11/mo for DigitalOcean Standard and is billed hourly. Autonomous WordPress autoscaling is a separate product line — do not treat the Flexible $11 floor as Autonomous. Same hosting-providers cluster as WP Engine (managed hosting), not hosting-operations (panel licences). Landscape-only versus Plesk/cPanel. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Cloudways when managed multi-cloud hosting is the job — not a Plesk/cPanel panel licence, and not WP Engine’s WordPress-only specialist path by default.
verdict: Choose Cloudways when managed multi-cloud hosting is the job — not a Plesk/cPanel panel licence, and not WP Engine’s WordPress-only specialist path by default. Compare WP Engine for managed WordPress-specialist hosting; Plesk or cPanel only if you need a control-panel licence on infrastructure you already run (landscape, not a peer rank). Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Managed console over cloud VMs is easier than raw IaaS, but still more knobs than WP Engine’s WordPress-only UX. Not a lab test.
Primary job is managed multi-cloud hosting — hosting-providers cluster with WP Engine, not Plesk/cPanel panel licences.
Flexible stack + separate Autonomous WordPress line cover managed hosting workflows; not a hosting-panel reseller OS.
WordPress and API/cloud-provider plumbing are the integration story.
Managed platform security is real; not a panel-licence hardening kit and not WP Engine’s WordPress-specialist posture.
Hourly Flexible plus Autonomous autoscaling scale; TCO still follows VM size and cloud choice.
Published $11 DigitalOcean Standard floor is the sharpest managed-host entry here. Affiliate economics excluded.
No meaningful ITSM/dev AI copilot — scored low; hosting job rarely needs AI scoring depth.
